map.二手房市场价快速评估（比较法）: Second-hand home market value quick estimate (comparison method)
map.可取市场可比交易的 NOI/售价，或风险溢价法（无风险利率+房产风险溢价），住宅: Take the NOI/sale price ratio from comparable market transactions, or use the risk premium method (risk-free rate + property risk premium); 4%-5% is common for residential and 5%-7% for commercial.
map.填写「土地价值(万元)-剩余法用」。: Fill in "land value (10,000 CNY) - used by the residual method".
map.填写「年毛租金收入(万元)」。: Fill in "annual gross rental income (10,000 CNY)".
map.开发项目用剩余法扣减土地价值求建筑物价值。: For development projects, the residual method subtracts the land value to derive the building value.

map.收益还原法评估工具，基于V=NOI/r公式计算房产价值，输入年租金、空置率、运营: Income capitalisation appraisal tool based on the formula V = NOI / r: enter annual rent, vacancy rate, operating expense ratio and capitalisation rate, and it automatically computes the net operating income (NOI) and the assessed value.
map.毛租金倍数 GRM=售价/年租金，>25 倍通常回报偏低，<15 倍回报较高，需: Gross rent multiplier GRM = sale price / annual rent; above 25 usually means a low return and below 15 a high return, but net income has to be judged together with vacancy and costs.
map.用 GRM、租售比判断投资回报率高低。: Use the GRM and the rent-to-price ratio to judge how high the investment return is.
map.稳定收租型物业按 NOI÷资本化率直接估值。: Income-stable rental property is valued directly as NOI divided by the capitalisation rate.
map.资本化率怎么选？: How do I choose the capitalisation rate?
map.：年租金 120 万、空置 5% → 有效租金 114 万；运营费 25% →: : annual rent 1.2 million with 5% vacancy -> effective rent 1.14 million; operating cost 25% -> NOI = 114 x 75% = 855,000; capitalisation rate 5% -> value V = 855,000 / 0.05 = 17.1 million, giving a rent-to-price ratio of 1.2 / 17.1 ~= 7.0%.
map.：总开发价值按 NOI/资本化率得 1710 万，扣土地价值 600 万 → 建: : total development value from NOI divided by the capitalisation rate is 17.1 million; subtract the land value of 6 million -> building value 11.1 million. Suitable for property under construction or awaiting development.
